248:61.en: 「$$マリーダ・クルス$$, commencing attack!」

248:776.en: 「I've no use for a Gundam knockoff!」

248:815.en: 「$$バナージ$$...! I won't hold back...!」

248:938.en: 「I won't let $$ロンド・ベル$$ interfere!」

248:973.en: 「$$ロンド・ベル$$ has entered the fray...!」

248:1089.en: 「A concept opposite to $$クシャトリヤ$$...!」

248:1132.en: 「A bloated machine is just a target!」

248:1173.en: 「Faster or not,\nI have ways to fight!」

248:1339.en: 「To think I'd have to fight this...!」

248:1634.en: 「It can be used this way too...!」

248:1819.en: 「Now that I know where you are!」

248:2004.en: 「$$ギュネイ$$, I'll lend you a hand!」

248:2104.en: 「To think I'd aid $$ロンド・ベル$$...」

248:2428.en: 「We'll take them down one by one!」
alternatives: We'll pick them off one by one!

248:2583.en: 「I let my chance to counter slip...!」

248:3018.en: 「Even a Gundam is no match for me...!」

248:3882.en: 「As an Enhanced, can't I beat them?!」

248:4012.en: 「No...! I can't let it consume me...!」

248:4211.en: 「They pushed $$クシャトリヤ$$ this far...!」

248:4519.en: 「I'll drop them one by one, surely!」

248:4814.en: 「The $$νガンダム$$ can surely do it...!」

248:4851.en: 「$$ターンエー$$'s power, to carry history on!」

248:5014.en: 「If I fail, I'll just keep trying...!」

248:5084.en: 「The Princess said it...!\nShe won't walk the same path as you!」

248:5137.en: 「I can't let you run free, you who\nthreaten the world and the Princess!」

248:5190.en: 「I'll end this, $$フル・フロンタル$$!」

248:5227.en: 「I won't lose to you, who hides your\nexistence behind the word 'vessel'!」

248:5286.en: 「I'll repay you for running amok,\n$$アンジェロ$$!」

248:5386.en: 「I'll make you let me through,\n$$アンジェロ・ザウパー$$!」

248:5439.en: 「Calm down and look around you,\n$$バンシィ$$ pilot!」

248:5494.en: 「Don't fight misled by the $$バンシィ$$!\nAt this rate, you'll...!」

248:5555.en: 「I have to make you see that\nlight is dangerous...!」

248:5604.en: 「I won't let you bar us from the Box!」

248:5680.en: 「Why can't you see you're dancing\nto the Foundation's tune?!」

248:5731.en: 「Lady $$ハマーン$$...!\nIf you'd obstruct the Princess...!」

248:5782.en: 「If they fuse with us, we're done!」

248:5819.en: 「For now, we just have to stop them!」

248:5862.en: 「I can't let the invaders get away!」

248:6067.en: 「Something that tries to rule people\ncan never be a god!」

248:6237.en: 「I'll cut $$サイデリアル$$ strength a bit...!」

248:6278.en: 「If I leave you alone, the colonies\nwill be dragged in sooner or later!」

248:6341.en: 「Against a Reactor, I don't know\nhow far I can go, but...!」

248:6400.en: 「The glow of your $$スフィア$$...!\nIt's a light of ruin!」

248:6451.en: 「Know the Empire's sun is setting,\n$$アウストラリス$$!」

248:6500.en: 「You'll answer for all the fighting\nuntil now!」

248:6555.en: 「I'll credit your stance against\na cursed fate, at least! But!」

248:6663.en: 「You who ignore people's prayers\ncan't be emissaries of God!」

248:6732.en: 「The light we should cling to is\nnever the likes of you!」

248:6797.en: 「This man...!\nWhat's he thinking behind a smile?!」

248:6893.en: 「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll defeat you\nand return to my Master!」

248:6985.en: 「I'll teach you that the light you\ncling to is a sham!」

248:7206.en: 「If even one shot lands, I win!」

248:7609.en: 「This power...!\nUsing it to link time to the future!」

248:7739.en: 「I can't let you go like this!」

248:7832.en: 「$$バナージ$$, leave the rest to me!」

248:7983.en: 「Being near the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$\nturned out lucky...!」

248:8038.en: 「$$ロンド・ベル$$ isn't your only enemy!」

248:8075.en: 「I won't watch my allies get hurt...!」

248:8135.en: 「I won't let anyone touch $$バナージ$$!」

248:8222.en: 「I can't let the $$赤い彗星$$ fall...!」

248:8257.en: 「This time I'll protect Lady $$ハマーン$$!」

248:8290.en: 「Captain $$オットー$$, I'll shield you here!」

248:8329.en: 「That'd disgrace the $$ロンド・ベル$$ name!」

248:8491.en: 「I won't let you have your way!」

248:8594.en: 「Are you trying to test me,\n$$フル・フロンタル$$!」

248:8645.en: 「Is this your 'vessel of humanity's\ncollective will,' $$フル・フロンタル$$?!」

248:8702.en: 「Even if you bring out\na giant mobile armor...!」

248:8753.en: 「I won't lose to a man so small...!」

248:8794.en: 「$$アンジェロ$$!\nThe presence you give off is warped!」

248:8876.en: 「Looks like the $$バンシィ$$ is\njerking you around too...!」

248:8929.en: 「Can't draw out the $$バンシィ$$'s power?!」

248:9046.en: 「Not to a soldier with no conviction,\nmerely made to dance...!」

248:9429.en: 「I won't lose to one who gave up...!」

248:9472.en: 「You're not called the Red Comet's\nreturn for nothing...!」

248:9525.en: 「The Box will go to $$フル・フロンタル$$...!」

248:9617.en: 「Stop it, $$アンジェロ$$!\nHatred will swallow you!」

248:9670.en: 「$$ハマーン・カーン$$!\nIs this what you truly intend?!」

248:9729.en: 「Is it fully under control...?!\nThat black Gundam!」

248:9790.en: 「Stop fighting! At this rate, there's\nno taking it back!」

248:9857.en: 「If you wish for $$ジオン$$'s future,\nstop fighting right now!」

248:9953.en: 「Damn the Foundation, they'll seize\nthe Box at any cost...!」

248:10006.en: 「I can't give up...!\nI'll struggle to the very end!」

248:10065.en: 「Don't throw away hope...!\nA chance will surely come...!」

248:10114.en: 「No matter how hopeless things get,\nI will resist!」

248:10216.en: 「Sorry...! This is as far as I go...!」

248:10345.en: 「Your earnest heart hurts others and you... Calm down and look around」

248:10424.en: 「The world is wide... So many people resonate together...」

248:10483.en: 「You were my light... The light that gave me life again...」

248:10567.en: 「Princess... $$マリーダ・クルス$$ ends here...」

248:10610.en: 「Keep a firm hold on $$バナージ$$, Princess. Or else he...」

248:10677.en: 「Another game over, $$バナージ$$? Not enough practice?」

248:10758.en: 「Then retry after a game over. You keep your funds and levels.」

248:10841.en: 「You can always start over. People... and games...」

248:10898.en: 「But a retry after game over forfeits SR Points. Do mind that.」

248:10991.en: 「Good luck, $$バナージ$$... and to you players, too.」
